chronology: Original field-training method failed insufficient training stars; preserved. Gaia field-only identity and DQ association diagnosed saturation and absolute pointing. This calibration protocol changes instrumental response calibration, not frozen physical lens predictions.
identity_selection: Independent Gaia FIELD stellar classification and proper motion; source lies outside10arcsec lens guard, is available in all4nativefootprints and has saturated DQ cores. It was selected before any external PSF-fit agreement. Original compact candidate field0002 has no Gaia counterpart and is not used.
proper_motion: First-order ICRS alpha-star/declination Gaia2016 to native2022-10-12 epoch; explicit cosine once. Less than0.1arcsec transport; used for association only.
association: Nearest8-connected SAT-pixel component within60pixels of Gaia-GWCS expected location; center from DQ-pixel center-of-mass, without SCI weighting; guarded target pixels unavailable.
star_fit: Fixed17x17native wings fit; exclude DNU|SAT, nonfinite SCI, nonpositive/nonfiniteERR. Freecentroid2/positiveflux1/affinebackground3, no shape/width fit; knownERRinverseinformationcovariance no rescaling. Finite external PSF calibration uncertainty remains conditional.
field_gate: All4prespecified star applications must have optimizer success, interior parameters, rank6 and knownERR p>=.001. Saturated core values do not enter fit. No disagreement-based clipping or star substitution.
library: Official STScI empirical LMC COM1074/CAL1476 ePSF, NRCB3 F115W;25spatialfiducials5x5,101x101samples; officialPhotutilsSTDPSFreader supplies FITS-origin and spatialinterpolation conventions. No HE0435photons used in library training.
grid_normalization: sum(grid)/16=1 once after spatial interpolation; freeflux absorbs normalization. ePSF is pixel-integrated and is evaluated without a second pixel integral. Preserve negative learned wings.
native_pixel_area: Native SCI/ERR directly, matching official JWST1PASS consumer convention; no unprescribed PAM multiplication. Flux pixel-area correction is distinct from centroid geometry.
field_registration: Translation=fitted field-star native centroid minus Gaia-epoch nominal GWCS pixel position. Add only to frozen NIC2-reference association guesses; no target centroids, scale, shear, affine geometry or lens parameters fit. Sample quasar PSFs at those field-registered detector positions before target opening.
target_psf_files: Perexposure nested A/B/C/D fixed grids, full filehash table. Field registration guesses/derivation and all PSF grids must be committed before root authorizes any target SCI access.
uncertainty_scope: Conditional known native ERR and fixed independent empirical PSF at spatial position; unmodeled epoch/color/calibration-star noise and absolute distortion covariance remain explicit. No residual floor, covariance inflation or chi2-rescaling; no physical admission. One field star per exposure gives limited spatial and spectral validation coverage.
